samples: This program defines a simple arithmetic expression evaluator that represents math operations as a tree structure with support for addition, multiplication, and negation of decimal numbers. It provides two main functions: one to compute the numerical result of an expression tree, and another to convert the tree back into readable infix notation with parentheses. When run, it demonstrates both capabilities by constructing a sample expression, printing it in readable form alongside its computed value.
